sourceBreakdowns.title: DOL ETA FY2024 state unemployment benefits paid by jurisdiction
sourceBreakdowns.basis: DOL ETA 2112 state unemployment-fund transactions for October 2023 through September 2024, summing net regular UI, state-share extended, and reimbursable state-law benefits on lines 31–35. The 53 jurisdiction rows total $36.68974628469B, which is $78.74628469M (0.2151%) above Treasury's rounded $36.611B modified-cash outlay. This state-ledger view is separate and non-additive; no balancing residual is invented.

PBGC's audited FY2024 cash-flow statement reports the same program at $14.638B after rounding to millions. This plan-level SFA view is not additive to Treasury's $11.950B PBGC net outlay, which combines other benefit, assistance, operating, and receipt flows.
